summary: Acme Robotics sells warehouse picking robots and raised a Series A in 2026. Demand signals are strong, but two well-funded competitors and a recent layoff need explaining before investing.

facts.text: Raised a $24M Series A in March 2026.

evidence.quote: Acme Robotics announced a $24M Series A

facts.text: Hiring 14 field engineers in Texas and Ohio, suggesting new warehouse deployments.
Customers on Reddit praise pick speed but complain about setup time.

evidence.quote: Fast once running, but setup took us 6 weeks

risks.text: Two competitors raised larger rounds in the last 6 months.

evidence.quote: Rival B closed a $45M Series B
Rival A, a warehouse robotics startup

risks.text: Laid off about 10% of staff in September 2026.

open_questions: What is revenue per deployed robot after the price cut?
Why the September layoff, and which teams?
How do you win against the two better-funded competitors?
